description: Fetch a dispute in full: its status, claim and evidence deadline, both sides' signed evidence references, and, once triage has run, the triage result (verdict: refund, uphold, or null when escalated), its rationale, the inputs the rules ran on, and the ledger signature over the result. Read-only — one network read, no key required, and safe to poll while a dispute is open.

disputeDigest.description: 0x-prefixed digest of the dispute to fetch, as returned by open_dispute

name: get_dispute
title: Get dispute record
